title: config/owner-checks.json
description: The checks that own each tracked path, read by scripts/kit/owner-check.mjs: make owner-check runs the owners of the changed paths, never the full suite.

always.description: Node test files that run for every change; they do not make a path owned.

testTarget.description: A make target that runs node test files given in its variable TESTS; without it the tests run through scripts/kit/run-tests.mjs.

fullSuite.description: Make targets that run the full suite besides the targets whose recipe starts full-run.mjs; an owner rule never selects them.

paths.description: Globs of repository paths: * within a segment, ** across segments, {a,b} either.

targets.description: Make targets of the Makefile or of a file it includes.

scripts.description: Scripts of the root package.json, run as npm run <script>.

workspaces.description: Workspaces with a test script, run as npm test -w <name>.

prefixes.description: Package directories outside the workspaces with a test script, run as npm test --prefix <directory>.

tests.description: Node test files; $path is the changed test file itself.

variable.description: The make variable that receives the matched changed paths for the targets of the rule.

inputs.description: The paths that a check reads. A check is named make <target>, npm run <script>, npm test -w <workspace> or npm test --prefix <directory>; each path needs a rule that selects the check (a make target also through a target that runs it as a prerequisite).
